subject: Pennecon wharves in Forteau damaged - Strait of Belle Isle
text:
Pennecon wharves in Forteau damaged - Strait of Belle Isle
Pennecon wharves in approximate position 51 28.55N 056 55.2W have suffered armor stone washout with cribs remaining intact. Cribs sit approximately 160 meters from shore line. 

Caution.
